title: Tier-D MNT loan 1: overdue entirely inside an active pause reads zero delinquent days (4 overdue -> 0)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the delinquent block of Tier-D MNT loan 1 at business date 2023-10-20. request.delinquency carries the observed overdue-since civil date 2023-10-16 (delinquent.pastDueDate [2023,10,16]), the business date, the observed graceOnArrearsAgeing 3, and the paused-day count 4 derived from the active pause period [2023-10-16, 2023-10-20] the read-back carries. expect.overdue_days 4 and expect.delinquent_days 0 are TRANSCRIPTIONS of delinquent.pastDueDays 4 and delinquent.delinquentDays 0. THE PROPERTY GRADED: a period the loan is paused for does not age into delinquency, and the subtraction is FLOORED AT ZERO — DelinquentDays(4, 4, 3) = 4 - 4 - 3 = -3 -> 0, never a negative day count. OverdueDays(2023-10-16, 2023-10-20) = 4; the pause [2023-10-16, 2023-10-20] covers the whole overdue window, so paused = Min(2023-10-20, business 2023-10-20) - Max(2023-10-16, overdue 2023-10-16) = 4; grace 3 is corroborated by delinquent.delinquentDate [2023,10,19] = pastDueDate + 3. The observed delinquentDays 0 DOES reproduce under the port's DelinquentDays from the observed inputs, so no port discrepancy is recorded here. A port that counts the paused days as delinquent reads 4 - 3 = 1 and goes red. NOT GRADED: the negative clamp in OverdueDays (no overdue date is after the business date), and any balance-named cell (none appears in this vector). This is tenant `tierd`, NOT tenant `gerege`.
